subject: Re: Next steps after demo — VPC / Dedicated deployment option
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps and recap from today's demo — VPC option

Hi Alex / Priya,

Great to meet today — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same plan: 

Summary
- Primary use case: secure, low-latency inference for transaction risk scoring + in-product assistant.
- Current constraints: PII handling requirements, in-region data residency, and procurement timeline.

What we demo'd
- Standard hosted API for rapid integration (tokens-based).
- Dedicated/Dedicated VPC option: reserved capacity with a private VPC endpoint and customer-managed networking (good fit for regulated workloads).

Suggested next steps
1) I shared an initial Dedicated pricing slide during the call — attaching the PDF with a range and sizing examples.
2) If the team wants to explore Private (VPC/on-prem) we can schedule a short technical Q&A with our infra lead (Jonas) to cover network/connectivity and KMS options.
3) Please share any compliance buyers we should loop in (security, procurement).

Questions for you
- Is VPC/on-prem a requirement for you to proceed, or would a hosted + strict data controls be acceptable to start?
- Target procurement window? (E.g., next 30/60/90 days)

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-pricing.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to set up the technical call next week if that helps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bump — follow-up on VPC option and technical Q&A

Hi Alex —

Just bumping this in case it got buried. wanted to check whether VPC/on-prem is something you want to prioritize or whether starting on hosted + DLP controls is more realistic for the next sprint.

If VPC is on the table, Jonas can do a 30-minute technical Q&A to make sure networking and key management are aligned with your security team. We also have a short checklist we can send your infra/security folks to speed internal review.

Would a quick slot next Tue or Wed work for you?

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Sorry for the delay — we've been triaging priorities post-quarter close.

Short answers:
- VPC/on-prem is our preference long-term for sensitive transaction data, but we may pilot on hosted first if the procurement/policy path for VPC takes too long.
- Procurement timeline has shifted; looks like procurement/security will only prioritize this in the next quarter (starting July).

Would like to take you up on the technical Q&A so we can map requirements for the security team — Priya (cc) will coordinate availability.

Also can you send the SOC2 summary and a short one-pager that outlines the network checklist for our infra team? That will help us prepare.

Thanks,
Alex
